author: Itzko
quote: Didn't plan on buying this game as I also didn't play GTA V, then I saw it got pretty much perfect scores across the board and bought it. First mission was nice, then I tried doing GTA things like stealing a car and running over people for money. YOU CANT STEAL NICE CARS AND CARS IN YOUR NEIGHBORHOOD!!! SOME NPCS ARE INVINCIBLE!!! (Protestors and LGBT) then I spent 2 hours in something worse than an unskippable cutscene, an unskippable cutscene where I need to click random buttons to move furniture and do manual labor around the house, then an hour doing chores then 20 minutes talking to boring NPCs in a bar. Stopped myself there and asked for a refund. Also I hate both main characters
